features.title: Resume the latest stopped task
features.summary: Resume beside the latest task a restart or a failed model request stopped, while the Host confirms it remains idle; superseded history stays read-only.
failureModes: Missing recovery owner hides the action.
Resume failures keep a retryable action.

verification.testName: disables Resume while pending, reports errors, and hides after acceptance

features.title: Retry a turn that failed before any reply
features.summary: Retry replaces Resume beside the latest turn that stopped before the model replied (a sign-in, quota or transport failure): the same request runs again behind a compact notice instead of a continue prompt.
failureModes: A Host without the retry verb keeps offering Resume.
Retry refuses once the turn is superseded, busy or partly answered.

verification.testName: offers Retry for a task that produced nothing and sends it to the retry verb, not resume
runs a turn that failed before any reply again, with a notice instead of a continue prompt

features.title: Open a thread on its latest messages
features.summary: A thread opens with the rows that fill the viewport mounted; older rows mount as the transcript scrolls up.
failureModes: A navigation or find target outside the mounted rows widens the window before it scrolls.
Rows the reader scrolls past must not snap back when older rows mount: a paging anchor armed mid-gesture yields to the reader's scroll.
reach: expect textbox "Describe what you want to build, / commands, @ files or sessions"

verification.testName: mounts the latest rows first and widens toward older rows

telemetry.reason: Client-only: Open a thread on its latest messages renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Open image links in the gallery
features.summary: Opening an image link or read_image path shows it in the shared gallery, with the clicked image selected; the gallery defaults to the current Turn and can be configured to include the entire thread.

configuration.constraints: Choose current Turn or all images in the thread; older history loads when needed.

failureModes: A supported image link opens the side panel instead of the gallery.
The current-Turn gallery includes images from another Turn.
The sidebar and composer remain visually at the same layer as the gallery.

verification.testName: defaults to the current turn and accepts thread scope in saved Chat settings
opens a resolvable local image link in the gallery

telemetry.reason: Client-only: Open image links in the gallery renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Scroll to a turn, step or tool call on request
features.summary: Another plugin asks Chat to scroll to and highlight one turn, step or tool call: through the native Conversation View focus request inside the thread, or a pending request right after it opens the thread (@dshfiles/chat/chat-focus). Chat jumps through the turn rail, opens the folded process group with the beforematch event browser find uses, and outlines the row; Turn-footer entries get the thread's View opener.
failureModes: A tool call or step that never appears within 4 s lands on its turn.
A cross-thread request expires after 30 s when the thread never shows Chat.
reach: click button "Open the trace of turn*"

verification.testName: round-trips a focus through the opaque view-request string and refuses anything else
opens a folded group with beforematch, then scrolls to and highlights the tool call it mounts

telemetry.reason: Client-only: scrolling Chat to a requested turn, step or tool call reads browser state and starts no Host work of its own.
